---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an addition or improvement
labels: enhancement
title: "[FEAT] "
assignees: ''
---

**Problem**
What currently can't be done, or is painful/clunky.

**Proposed solution**
What you want, concretely.

**Where it fits** (check one)
- [ ] L0 reflex detector (new rule? suggest rule ID, predicate, and weight)
- [ ] L1 ML classifier (features, training changes)
- [ ] Arbitration (union/intersect, thresholds)
- [ ] Experiments / evaluation
- [ ] Project / packaging / CI

**Acceptance criteria**
What has to be true for this to count as done (e.g., "arbitration_report.md shows improved F1 on the 580-sample benchmark").
